links.outcome: Agreement (kappa) with human expert iGuide justification of brain CT referrals, chatbots vs custom prediction model
links.effect: Chatbots' performance was limited (κ = 0.3), improving for more complete referrals; the custom prediction model reached κ = 0.853 on the same referrals.
links.quote: The prediction model outperformed the chatbots in justification analysis (κ = 0.853).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) alongside a custom prediction model against human expert review for justifying real-world adult brain CT referrals based on clinical guidelines, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
